mode: independent actual signed managed-voice entrypoint; reused activation/SDK protocol fixture primitives, independently designed boundary cases; physical networking denied

checks.name: destination failures, missing/unknown status and unbridged completion speak recovery from the Dial action
parent transport status cannot certify destination connection; completed child is transport evidence only
signed account, parent/caller/number/token and signature mismatches cannot alter a retained call
known shop-number, managed-number and caller/destination loops never emit a Dial
concurrent preterminal retries and discarded responses emit one local Dial and one nonrefundable fallback reservation
terminal replay is immutable and a conflicting known destination SID is rejected
AI and fallback consume distinct existing allowance keys including ring buffer; minute exhaustion blocks a new parent
exhausted account or malformed allowance fails closed without a new paid attempt
unchanged approved fallback survives stale AI, paused AI and actual voice-only route detach
workspace replacement/cancel, parent release/cancel, account brake and provider-policy withdrawal stop paid fallback
final serving read refuses a changed owner, global withdrawal or generation after one retained attempt
lost SDK acknowledgement after attempt commit never authorizes a second Dial
elapsed admission reduces connection duration while preserving the 25+5 second cost envelope
signed known owner-cell forwarding reentry is message-only while ordinary shop forwarding remains allowed
a stored policy that differs from its approved bound digest cannot enlarge fallback duration
destination completion without a child SID remains unknown rather than a confirmed destination receipt
missing retained duration cannot corrupt the shared paid allowance before failing closed
retained original owner-cell forwarding cannot be erased by an omitted fallback callback field
